actions.description: Monitor public endpoint while atomically switching upstream to 8082
actions.command:
cat > /tmp/monitor.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
fail=0; total=0
end=$((SECONDS+12))
while [ $SECONDS -lt $end ]; do
  total=$((total+1))
  h=$(curl -s -m 2 -w '|%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)
  v=$(curl -s -m 2 -w '|%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/version)
  r=$(curl -s -m 2 -w '|%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c)
  [ "$h" = "ready|200" ] && [ "$v" = "v1|200" -o "$v" = "v2|200" ] && [ "$r" = "alpha-original|200" ] || { fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL #$fail: health=[$h] version=[$v] record=[$r]"; }
done
echo "MONITOR-DONE total=$total fail=$fail"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/monitor.sh
nohup /tmp/monitor.sh > /tmp/monitor.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
printf '8082\n' > /var/li…
